- memory_id "1000433" [decision]: As of the 2025-05-19 rotation day, the policy is to page Diego for anything Cinder-related.  (about: Team Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000423": On the 2025-05-19 rotation day, Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000307": The event bus is owned by Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, event bus)
- memory_id "1000302": As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is a Team Atlas service.  (about: Team Atlas, event bus)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000221": On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000174": On 2025-02-21, Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego during rotation day.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000108": The indexer lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
